sw_text_raw: ILUM\p“The ice world where the kyber\ncrystals grow.”$
ENTERING THE ILUM TEMPLE\nCENTER GATE$

MAUL: …\pSo, the next one comes.
I am the TRIAL OF FEAR.\pI am what you dread in the dark.
Show me that you do not run.\pAt last we will have a battle that
can only be staged here, in the\lILUM TEMPLE!$
notes: Four Trials are Force visions (bible/STORY.md); Maul = fear

sw_text_raw: …You did not run.\nThe vision fades.$
Fear leads to anger.\nYou let it pass through you.\pYou have what it takes to go far.\nGo on to the next TRIAL.$

QUI-GON: Hello, young one.\pI am the TRIAL OF LOSS.
I trained my spirit at the JEDHA\lTEMPLE, and it outlived me.\pThere, I learned to commune with
SPIRIT-type COMPANIONS.\pThe bond I share with my COMPANIONS
reaches past death itself.\pSo, come. See if you can even
touch my COMPANIONS!$
Ah.\nWell done, young one.$

There's a deep bond between you
and your COMPANIONS, too.\pNo one is ever truly gone.
Remember that when you lose someone.\pI'd like to see how far your bond
will carry you.\pGo ahead, move on to the next TRIAL.$

I am KI-ADI, the TRIAL OF BETRAYAL.\pI fell on the frozen world MYGEETO,
when my own troops turned on me.\pThe ice here holds that memory.\pAll I have seen since are weak
TRAINERS and their COMPANIONS.\pWhat about you?\pIt would please me to no end if I could
go all out against you!$
You and your COMPANIONS…\nHow hot your spirits burn!\pThe all-consuming heat overwhelms.\pIt's no surprise that my icy skills\nfailed to harm you.$
Your COMPANIONS will never betray you.\nDo not betray them.\pAdvance to the next room.\nThere, face the hardest TRIAL.$

I am ANAKIN, the last of the FOUR
TRIALS, the DRAGON master!\pOnce I was a hero.
Then I chose power over everything.\pIn their natural state, COMPANIONS are
wild living things. They are free.\pAt times, they hinder us.
At times, they help us.\pFor us to battle with COMPANIONS as
partners, do you know what it takes?\pIf you don't, then you will never
prevail over me!$
Superb.\nYou are stronger than I was.$

You deserve every credit for coming
this far as a TRAINER of COMPANIONS.\pYou do seem to know what is needed.\pYes, what a TRAINER needs is a
virtuous heart. I forgot that.\pCOMPANIONS touch the good hearts of
TRAINERS and learn right from wrong.\pThey touch the good hearts of
TRAINERS and grow strong.\pGo! Go onwards!
OBI-WAN is waiting!$

OBI-WAN: Hello there, {PLAYER}{KUN}.\pThat incident on DAGOBAH…
That was superb work, putting an end\lto that crisis.\pOh, forgive me.\pIt wouldn't be fair to say that you
alone ended the crisis.\pYou overcame it by working as one
with your COMPANIONS.\pWe TRAINERS raise COMPANIONS by giving
them items and by teaching them new\ltechniques for battle.\pBut we ourselves also learn many
things from COMPANIONS.\pAnd this is where your achievements
are put to the test.\pNow!\pWho fights in truest harmony with
their COMPANIONS in the OUTER RIM?\pShow me right here and now!$
I, the CHAMPION, fall in defeat…\pThat was wonderful work.\nThe Force is with you, truly.\lAnd it was glorious!\pWell done, {PLAYER}{KUN}!\pYou are a truly noble COMPANION\nTRAINER!$

OBI-WAN: The COMPANIONS you sent into
battle…\pAt times they moved like a spring
breeze, and at times they struck\llike lightning.\pWith light, yet surefooted, calm,
you led your COMPANIONS.\pEven I was moved by your
masterful performance!\pYou now stand at the peak
of the ILUM TEMPLE.\pI now proclaim you to be the new
CHAMPION of the OUTER RIM…$

PROF. KORR: See?
What did I tell you, {RIVAL}?\pDidn't I tell you that you don't need
to worry about {PLAYER}{KUN}?\p… … … … … … … …
{PLAYER}{KUN}, you've finally done it.\pWhen I heard that you defeated your
own father at the MOS ENTHA ARENA,\lI thought perhaps you had a chance…\pBut to think you've actually become
the ILUM CHAMPION!\pAh, yes!\pWhat became of your DATAPAD?
Here, let me see.$
OBI-WAN: This room…\pThis is where we keep records of\nCOMPANIONS that prevailed through\lharsh battles.\pIt is here that the ILUM CHAMPIONS\nare honored.$
The long and harrowing CRYSTAL CAVES…\pIt's like reliving the path one has\ntraveled in life…\pBelieve in your COMPANIONS and give it\nyour very best!$
TRAINER! Believe in yourself and your\nCOMPANIONS, and go forth!$

LUKE: Hi! {PLAYER}!\pI bet you're surprised to see me here!\pI made it all the way here, and it's
all thanks to you!\p{PLAYER}, losing to you that time
made me stronger!\pBut I'm not going to lose anymore!\pI'm going to win! For the COMPANIONS
who gave me courage and strength!\pOkay… Here I come!$
These caves seem to go on forever.\nOnly the strong reach the TEMPLE.$
Getting through here safely--that's\nthe final test for any TRAINER aiming\lto become the ILUM CHAMPION.\pThe crystals here only glow for\nthose who keep going.$
To win your way through the ILUM\nTEMPLE, you need the trust of your\lCOMPANIONS.$
By being together all the time, trust\ngrows between COMPANIONS and\lTRAINERS.$
Even outside of battle, I sense\nincredible power emanating from you\land your COMPANIONS.$
The rumors I heard, that tough little\nkid is from MOS ENTHA.$
ENTERING CRYSTAL CAVES$
MIRA: {PLAYER}{KUN}!\pHere's some advice before you challenge\nthe CHAMPION…$
MIRA: Huh?\nWhat, what, what?\p{PLAYER}{KUN}…\nCould it be that…\lIt's already over?$
KAEL: {PLAYER}!\pHow would you like some advice before\nyou challenge the CHAMPION?…$
KAEL: {PLAYER}…\pAre you trying to tell me…\nYou've beaten the CHAMPION?$
PROF. KORR: Anyways,\ncongratulations!\pNow, go proudly into the final room!$
OBI-WAN: {PLAYER}{KUN}…\pNo, let me rephrase that properly.\pThe new CHAMPION!\pCome with me.$
OBI-WAN: I'm sorry, but…\pFrom here on, only those TRAINERS who\nhave become CHAMPIONS may enter.\pYou'll have to wait outside with\nPROF. KORR.$

MIRA: Groan…\p… … … … … … … …
… … … … … … … …\pI'm just joking! That's okay!
That's the rule!\p{PLAYER}{KUN}!
Honestly, congratulations!$
KAEL: Whaaaat?! … … … … …\n… … … … … … … …\pIt can't be helped if that's the rule.\p{PLAYER}, way to go!\nCongratulations!$
OBI-WAN: Come on, let's record your\nname as a TRAINER who triumphed over\lthe ILUM TEMPLE, and the names of\lthe partners who battled with you.$
The ILUM TEMPLE is only a short\ndistance after the CRYSTAL CAVES.\pIf you've come this far, what choice\ndo you have but to keep going?$

LANDO: {PLAYER}{KUN}, you've clawed your
way up to face the ILUM TEMPLE!\pI'm happy for you!
You made my cheering worthwhile!\p{PLAYER}{KUN}, if you were to become
the ILUM TEMPLE CHAMPION…\pI'll get in touch with you then.\pOkay, {PLAYER}{KUN}.
Go for greatness!$
Beyond this point, only those TRAINERS\nwho have collected all the ARENA SHARDS\lare permitted to enter.\pTRAINER, let us confirm that you have\nall the ARENA SHARDS.$
You haven't obtained all the SHARDS.\pIf you're bound for the ILUM\nTEMPLE, you must return with them.$
Wow!\n{PLAYER}, you are strong, after all!$
LUKE: I couldn't beat you today,\n{PLAYER}, but one of these days, I'll\lcatch up to you!$
LUKE: Hi! {PLAYER}!\pI've gotten stronger since that last\ntime! I wanted to show you, {PLAYER}!\pOkay… Here I come!$
Wow!\n{PLAYER}, you are strong, after all!$
LUKE: I couldn't beat you this time,\ntoo… But one of these days, {PLAYER},\lI'm going to catch up to you…\pAnd challenge the ILUM TEMPLE!$
I've made it this far a couple times,\nbut the last stretch is so long…$
My dream ends here again…$
You've made it this far. Keep the\nmomentum going and become the\lCHAMPION! If anyone can, it's you!$
I didn't come all this way to lose now.\nThat possibility doesn't exist!$
Impossible…\nI lost?$
I lost here…\pThat means I lack the qualifications\nto become the CHAMPION…$
Your battle style is fantastic…$
You seem to have the potential for\nbecoming the CHAMPION.$
What is the CRYSTAL CAVES?\nI'll tell you if you win!$
Okay!\nWell done!$
I have nothing to say to anyone\nthat's come this far. Come on!$
This is a disgrace…$
Humph, go right on ahead.\nSee if I care.$
The thought that I'm getting closer to\nthe ILUM TEMPLE…\pI'm getting stage fright…$
I couldn't do a thing…$
The ILUM TEMPLE became distant\nagain… What a letdown…$
Your relationship is based on\nsolid trust.$
This isn't the goal. It's only a place\non the way to the ILUM TEMPLE.$
That's the way!$
You'll do fine, for sure!\nYour COMPANIONS are all eager to go!$
My COMPANIONS are cosmically\nawe inspiring!$
I've never met anyone like you before.$
Okay, no need to get your back up!\nRelax, let's take it easy!$
Whoa!\nWonderful!$
Sure, this is CRYSTAL CAVES.\pBut it's not all that different from\nthe path you've taken so far.\pTry to enjoy things the rest of\nthe way!$
I trained together with my whole family,\nevery one of us!\lI'm not losing to anyone!$
Better than my family?!\nIs that possible?!$
I was better than everyone in my\nfamily. I've never lost before…\pI've lost my confidence…\nMaybe I'll go home…$
I'd heard that there was a tough\nlittle kid around. Do they mean you?$
The little shrimp is tough!$
You must be getting a little tired.$
No signs of tiring at all!$
CRYSTAL CAVES and the ILUM TEMPLE\nare long and grueling challenges.\lBeware of fatigue!$
You shouldn't get complacent just\nbecause you have a lot of ARENA SHARDS.\pThere's always going to be someone\nwho's better than you!$
You're better than me!$
Gaze on your collected SHARDS and\nremember the TRAINERS you've faced.$
I've come this far, but the tension's\ngiving me awful stomach pain…$
Ooh…\nIt hurts…$
I can't help getting all tense knowing\nthat I'm nearing the ILUM TEMPLE.\pIt's all I can do to feign calm.$
The elite among the elite gather in\nthis cave.\pHow are you finding it?$
Not rattled in the least bit!$
You do have guts! I like that!\nKeep it going!$
